specs.Compatible Devices: Smartphones, Laptops, Gaming Consoles, Blu-ray Players

features: Smart LED Projector: The Technoview Smart LED projector crafted with precision, this portable projector’s stunning visuals and better than ever user interface will take your home theater experience to a whole new level

Streaming Your Entertainment: It comes with Android 11-based OS, for direct access to a wide range of streaming services. Now seamlessly watch content from popular OTT platforms like Netflix, Prime Video, Jio Hotstar, YouTube, and more

Bright and Sharp Visuals: The projector’s 720 HD resolution and 150 ANSI brightness, ensure that your movies, shows, sports, etc. are always displayed in high-definition quality and impressive brightness, even in well-lit spaces
Auto Keystone Correction: Adopts automatic vertical correction and manual focus for distortion free images every time. Make precise screen adjustments without needing to reposition the projector

Adjustable Screen Size: This projector for home has an adjustable screen size from 40 inches to 100 inches with a projection distance ranging between 1.2 m to 4 m. Enjoy your movies, and games on a grand screen size
